summary: Frontend-only regression test for the in-game score-history modal fix in /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx. Verified in the small landscape viewport (900x420) that with 12 injected hands the modal is bounded inside the card, the ScrollView is scrollable, hand 12 (Donne 12) becomes visible after scrolling, and the Close (Fermer) button is fully visible and dismisses the modal. Regression path with an empty history also works (shows 'Aucune donne terminée pour l'instant' and Close works). Bug is fixed.

assertions.(c) Donne 12 row visible after scroll to: PASS (scrollTop=496 → row 225.5-243.5 inside container 151.5-271.5); also verified via mouse wheel scroll

notes: el.scrollTo(0, scrollHeight) via page.evaluate did not update scrollTop reliably in Playwright/RN-Web, but setting el.scrollTop directly (and real mouse-wheel via page.mouse.wheel) both scrolled the container to the bottom and made Donne 12 visible. This is a Playwright/RN-Web quirk, NOT a product bug.
Console emitted only benign warnings ('shadow*' style props deprecated; transform-origin DOM prop warning) - unrelated to this fix.
